limitations: This collection covers Finance circulars on payment modes (e-payment, NEFT, RTGS, CCPAP, cheques and fraud precautions) and claim forms (2009-2020). Investment, pension payments to designated banks, VDR collection accounts, salary advances and bonus circulars are not included.
Progress reports on e-payment implementation, individual DO letters and repeated near-identical reminders were not included; the series from 2010 to 2011 is partial.

The 2014 CCPAP (Cheque Cum Positive Pay) module circulars form a series (August to November 2014) of which only those in the issuer's table with English titles are included; the instructions in each should be read for the account number and offices it covers.
Links between successive NEFT, EDLI and fake-cheque circulars that cite earlier ones only as 'the above circular' or 'instructions issued earlier' are marked unverified.

The 2017 composite claim forms replace Forms 20, 10-D and 5-IF; the later 2017 revision is recorded as a partial modification of the March 2017 form; the 2020 circular on printing online claim forms is a scan with partial text and its effect is not recorded.

A few older circulars (2010, 2011) state 'immediate effect' with no date other than the issue date; those are recorded as effective on the issue date. The 2011 revised limits for fake-cheque precautions are recorded from 1 December 2011 as stated.
Dates follow the letter, not the issuer listing; entries whose letter date differs carry a date_note.

PDFs were read from the issuer mirror on 4 November 2026 because the public site returned 404 for these paths; recorded SHA-256 values apply to those files. Scanned pages are OCR. Issue dates were checked against the document headers.
